name: Xingji Mofashi -FromTheStars-
source:
"FromTheStars" is a realistic-themed visual novel with a 120,000-word text and five endings. Focused on real-life settings, the game tells the story of the male protagonist Reginald, who is abruptly and insistently demanded by the female protagonist Fiona to live together one day.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3776250]Steam[/url]]
